why: Geomorphic processes. A landform is a process acting on a material. Rates are relative (Earth rain = 1) and tagged. The compiler does not invent a stamp.

processes.name: impact cratering
processes.why: The universal clock on any solid surface. Density follows a power law; the current stamp still takes four hand-tuned counts.

processes.name: global contraction
processes.why: A one-plate lithosphere shrinks as the interior cools. Thrust scarps, not plate boundaries.

processes.name: silicate volcanism
processes.why: Shields, plains, wrinkle ridges. Viscosity and gas content decide the edifice; this cut only names the family.

processes.name: heat-pipe volcanism
processes.why: Io. Magma rises through a thin lid, buries the old surface, and the mountains are tilted blocks, not volcanoes.

processes.name: cryovolcanism
processes.why: The same volcanic grammar in ice or ammonia-water. Domes, flows, plumes, pits.

processes.name: tidal flexure
processes.why: Diurnal stress on an ice shell. Double ridges, cycloids, tiger stripes. Computable from an orbit the catalogue already carries.

processes.name: sublimation
processes.why: Pits, blades, hollows, spiders. Most of what the outer Solar System looks like up close, and it has no Earth analogue in the fluvial library.

processes.name: aeolian transport
processes.why: Dunes and yardangs wherever there is an atmosphere and loose grains. Titan's equator and Mars's deserts.

processes.name: fluvial erosion
processes.why: Liquid running downhill. Water on Earth, methane on Titan. Needs a liquid window at surface P.

processes.name: glacial ice
processes.why: Ice that flows. Cirques and moraines on Earth; convecting nitrogen is a different process.

processes.name: dissolution
processes.why: A soluble rock and a solvent. Limestone on Earth, organics-over-ice on Titan.

processes.name: solid-state convection
processes.why: Sputnik Planitia. A material soft enough at the local T to overturn in cells. Rheology, not tectonics.
